boundary.title: Owed, instructed and paid are three different things
boundary.run: A run calculates what is owed. Approving it freezes an approved obligation.
boundary.instruction: A disbursement instruction asks for payment. Marking it sent is only a simulation.
boundary.settlement: Pay counts as paid only on independent evidence, which this prototype cannot verify yet. Nothing here is ever shown as paid.

scopeLimited: You see the staff of your sites only. Totals cover them only; changes need every site of the employer.

blockerHelp.missing_pay: No pay terms were agreed for this person, so nothing is calculated. Agreeing pay terms is not part of this gate: exclude the person from this run with a reason.
blockerHelp.days_unconfirmed: A daily wage is paid for the days worked. HR attendance does not cover the whole month, so confirm the days worked from the attendance register.
blockerHelp.unpaid_leave_policy: HR shows approved unpaid leave in this period. No policy says how unpaid leave reduces pay, so nothing is deducted and the line is held. Exclude it until the committee adopts a policy.
blockerHelp.suspended_policy: The person is suspended. No policy says what is paid while suspended, so the line is held. Exclude it until the committee decides.

warningHelp.partial_month: Employed for part of the period: pay is prorated by calendar days, rounded to the paisa. This is a demo placeholder rule, not an adopted policy.
warningHelp.advance_held: An approved advance or loan has an instalment due this month. It is not deducted: the advance's payment to the employee cannot be verified yet (staff advance settlement).
warningHelp.absences: HR recorded absences in this period. Nothing is deducted: no absence policy has been adopted.
warningHelp.bank_unverified: The bank account on file is not verified. A disbursement instruction will hold this person's pay rather than send it.
warningHelp.leave_pending: Unpaid leave in this period is waiting for a decision. If it is approved, the line will be held.

runBlocker.stale: HR records changed after this version was calculated. Recalculate before submitting.
runBlocker.line_blockers: Some lines are held. Resolve them, or exclude the people with a reason.

policy.title: Policies payroll would need
policy.intro: No statutory rule, rate or legal threshold is assumed. Anything not configured is never applied.

key.statutory: Statutory deductions (income tax, EOBI, social security)

help.proration: Calendar days, rounded half up to the paisa. Used in the demo; needs owner approval before real use.
help.statutory: Shown as placeholders and never calculated, until an adviser confirms the rules.
help.overtime: Not calculated: no overtime rate or multiplier has been approved.
help.unpaid_leave: Not deducted: the line is held until a policy is adopted.
help.absences: Not deducted: absences are reported only.
help.advance_recovery: Instalments are listed but held: an advance's payment to the employee is not verified.

statutory.placeholder: Demo placeholder — configuration needed. Not calculated.

dashboard.title: Payroll overview
dashboard.intro: Staff pay for {{entity}}: what is owed, what is instructed, and what can be verified as paid. Every figure opens the records behind it.
dashboard.notAvailableHint: Verification needs evidence this prototype cannot check yet.
dashboard.noRun: No run prepared for this period yet.

attention.blocked_lines_one: {{count}} line is held in the current run
attention.blocked_lines_other: {{count}} lines are held in the current run
attention.stale: HR records changed: the current run needs recalculating
attention.awaiting_run_one: {{count}} run is waiting for your approval
attention.awaiting_run_other: {{count}} runs are waiting for your approval
attention.awaiting_instruction_one: {{count}} disbursement instruction is waiting for your approval
attention.awaiting_instruction_other: {{count}} disbursement instructions are waiting for your approval
attention.held_bank_one: {{count}} person's bank account is not verified
attention.held_bank_other: {{count}} people's bank accounts are not verified
attention.statutory: Statutory deductions are not configured (placeholders only)

periods.title: Payroll periods
periods.intro: One month per period, created in order. One period is open at a time; it closes once its run is approved.
periods.newSubtitle: The next month after the latest period.
periods.monthHint: Periods are created in order, from the month payroll was licensed. At most two months ahead.
periods.payDateHint: Up to 5 days before or 10 days after the month ends.

effect.open: Runs can then be prepared for this month. Only one period can be open at a time.
effect.close: No run of this period can change or be reversed afterwards. Closing pays nobody: disbursement and settlement stay separate.

run.title: Payroll run workspace
run.none: No run yet. Prepare one from an open period.
run.blockersTitle: Before this run can be submitted

effect.submit: It goes to an approver who made no part of it. It cannot be changed while waiting.
effect.withdraw: It becomes a draft again, so it can be changed.
effect.recompute: Every line is calculated again from today's HR records, keeping your inputs, as a new version.

run.approvedNote: Approved by {{name}} on {{date}}. This is an obligation: nothing has been paid.
run.csvNote: Demo export, fictional data. Net pay is owed, not paid.

breakdown.title: Employee pay breakdown
breakdown.daysHint: From 0 to {{max}} (the days employed in the period).
breakdown.bonusesOff: Bonuses are not part of your plan.
breakdown.appliedNone: No deduction is applied in this run.
breakdown.heldNone: No advance or loan instalment falls in this month.
breakdown.unpaidLeave: Approved unpaid leave: {{count}} days (no deduction policy)
breakdown.netExplain: Gross pay minus the deductions applied. It is what this run says is owed, before any statutory deduction (none is configured). It is not a payment.
breakdown.own: This is your own pay. You can see it but not change it, and you cannot approve a run that includes it.

effect.exclude: Their pay is left out of this run's obligation. Nothing is paid or owed through this run.
effect.include: Their pay is calculated in this run again, as a new version.
effect.removeBonus: The bonus is removed and the line recalculated as a new version.

finalisation.title: Payroll finalisation
finalisation.intro: Someone who made no part of a run, and has no pay in it, approves it. Approval freezes an obligation; it pays nobody.
finalisation.acknowledge: I understand this approves what is owed, not a payment, and that statutory deductions are not configured.
finalisation.approved: {{ref}} approved: an obligation, not a payment.

effect.return: It becomes a draft again for the preparer to change.
effect.reverse: The approved obligation is withdrawn. The period can then have a new run. No payment existed, so none is undone.

finalisation.frozen: Frozen: version {{version}} can no longer change.

disbursement.title: Pay instructions
disbursement.intro: Instructions to pay approved runs. Preparing, approving or marking one sent moves no money and changes nothing owed.
disbursement.partial: Instructions are tracked here, but no payment can be verified as made: that needs an outgoing payroll payment matched to a statement line of a verified account, once, by a second person. Until then every line stays “Not settled”.
disbursement.none: No approved run yet. Disbursement starts after a run is approved.
disbursement.approvedToast: {{ref}} approved: an instruction, not a payment.

effect.approve: This approves an instruction to pay. No money moves and nothing owed changes.
effect.send: This records that the instruction was handed over. It is a simulation: nothing is sent, paid or settled.
effect.cancel: The instruction stops. What is owed is unchanged.

needs.subject: A payroll payment subject: this run, this employee, this period and legal entity.
needs.account: The paying bank account verified, and the employee's account verified.
needs.line: A statement line of that account, imported, never typed in.
needs.match: One line settles one payment once; a partial match needs a second person.
needs.reversal: A reversed line restores what is owed.

accounting.title: Payroll accounting
accounting.intro: What approved runs would record, kept apart from anything actually posted. Nothing is posted from payroll.
accounting.partial: These entries are proposals. They are never posted: payroll has no approved accounting classification here, and no payment can be evidenced.
accounting.postedNone: None. Nothing is posted from payroll.

gaps.no_ledger: The society has no general ledger in this plan; the cashbook records evidenced cash only.
gaps.no_category: No accounting classification for payroll has been approved.
gaps.no_settlement: No payment can be evidenced yet, so nothing paid can be recorded.

history.line_removed: {{name}} left the run (no longer in this period's employer)

blocked.own_run: You prepared or changed this run, so someone else approves it.
blocked.own_line: Your own pay is in this run, so someone else approves it.
blocked.other_sites: This employer has sites outside your access, so only someone with all of them can act.
blocked.instruction_live: A disbursement instruction exists for this run. Cancel it before reversing.
blocked.period_closed: The period is closed: the run can no longer be reversed.
blocked.another_open: Another period is open. Close it first.
blocked.run_not_approved: The period closes once its run is approved.
blocked.frozen: The run is approved or reversed: it no longer changes.
blocked.submitted: The run is waiting for approval: withdraw it to change anything.
blocked.own_instruction: You prepared this instruction, so someone else approves it.

problems.otherSites: This employer has sites outside your access, so you cannot change this.
problems.ownRecord: Nobody changes or approves their own pay.
problems.makerChecker: You prepared or changed this, so someone else must decide it.
problems.stateChanged: This has changed since you opened it. Reload and try again.
problems.runExists: This period already has a run.
problems.runExistsDetail: Run {{ref}} already exists for this period.
problems.runFrozen: The run is approved or reversed: it no longer changes.
problems.runSubmitted: The run is waiting for approval. Withdraw it to make changes.
problems.runStale: HR records changed after this version was calculated. Recalculate first.
problems.lineBlockers: Some lines are held. Resolve them, or exclude the people with a reason.
problems.periodExists: That month already has a period.
problems.instructionLive: A disbursement instruction exists for this run.
problems.instructionExists: This run already has a live instruction.
problems.instructionSent: A sent instruction cannot be cancelled here; recalling it would need the bank.
problems.lineExcluded: This person is excluded from the run. Include them again first.
problems.trainingNotSupported: Payroll cannot be practised in training mode. Nothing was changed.

errors.periodOrder: Periods are created in order: the next one is {{month}}.
errors.periodTooFar: That month is more than two months ahead.
errors.payDate: Choose a pay date from 5 days before to 10 days after the month ends.
errors.notDaily: Days worked apply to a daily wage only.
errors.amount: Enter an amount above zero, with up to two decimals.
errors.bonusTooLarge: A bonus can be at most PKR 500,000.
errors.acknowledge: Confirm that this approves what is owed, not a payment.
